title: Phone OTP Verification

criteria_checked.AC1_correct_otp_marks_verified_and_statu: PASS (live end-to-end: seeded a synthetic complete-profile user + a known CodeHash in otp_attempts, ran user-service against the real DB, POSTed /auth/otp/verify with the correct code -> 200 {phone_verified:true,status:"active"}; confirmed in SQL that users.Phone/PhoneVerifiedAt were set and the otp_attempts row's code fields were cleared, single-use)
criteria_checked.AC2_wrong_otp_400_invalid_otp: PASS (live end-to-end: POSTed /auth/otp/verify with a wrong code -> 400 {code:"INVALID_OTP"}; confirmed in SQL that otp_attempts.AttemptCount incremented from 0 to 1 and WindowStartedAt was set)
criteria_checked.AC3_five_failures_429_otp_locked: PASS (live end-to-end: drove 5 total wrong-code attempts on one phone; SQL confirmed AttemptCount=5 and LockedUntil=now+15min; a 6th call -> 429 {code:"OTP_LOCKED", message containing the ISO lockout timestamp}, matching LockedUntil exactly)

last_note: RESOLVED. Confirmed via `dotnet ef migrations list` (run from src/services/user-service against localhost:14330, the mapped host port for the sqlserver container) that all 3 migrations, including 20260830174655_AddOtpVerificationFields, show as applied (no Pending marker) -- and cross-checked directly against __EFMigrationsHistory plus INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS in the live UserServiceDb container, which confirmed otp_attempts has CodeHash/CodeCreatedAt/CodeExpiresAt/WindowStartedAt and users has PhoneVerifiedAt. Tech Lead's `dotnet ef database update` had already been run. Migration file's Up() matches the EF model exactly (5 AddColumn calls, correct types/nullability). Both user-service and api-gateway rebuilt clean (0 warnings/errors). No xUnit test project exists yet for user-service, so verification was done by running user-service live against the real DB (dotnet run, bypassing the gateway since JWT issuance/validation is out of scope for this ticket -- X-User-Id was supplied directly per the JWT Identity rule that OtpController only ever reads that header) and exercising all 3 ACs with real HTTP calls; POST /auth/otp/send was not live-exercised since .env only has Twilio placeholder credentials (no real Twilio account provisioned) -- OtpService.SendOtpAsync's idempotent-resend logic and code generation were verified by code review only. All synthetic test rows (1 user, 2 otp_attempts) were deleted after verification; DB left clean (0 rows in both tables, confirmed by count query).
